policy.peak_frequency_note: Roster targets, not rarity or pack odds. IV's 8s are capped at 10%; other fractions are draft variety targets. Existing peak-bearing identities count toward each target.
policy.corner_interpretation: IV: an 8 permits at most 4 opposite, 3 adjacent. V: an 8 permits at most 5 opposite, 4 adjacent. VI: a 9 permits at most 5 opposite, 4 adjacent.
policy.tier_three_exception: A 7 permits at most 4 on every other side. Rare/Epic/Legendary may instead have one 5, with the remaining two sides at most 3.
policy.upper_tiers: VII is in standard play for non-unique identities. Unique cards stay reserved except released signature copies.

briefs.decision: The Tribunal, Dagoth Ur and lesser gods remain unfinished Tier IX candidates.

rarityNotes.Common: Three layouts per tier: adjacent edges, opposing edges and a broader spread.
rarityNotes.Rare: Extra strength or two strong adjacent sides; tier I–III defaults add two printed points over the typical Common.
rarityNotes.Epic: The highest single edge in its tier's starting five, paid for with exposed flanks. Printed totals can be lower than Rare.
rarityNotes.Legendary: Unique trophy slots in tiers VIII–IX; God trophies also use tier X.
